title: Chapter 4 A Thousand-Year Agreement
content:
Chapter 4 A Thousand-Year Agreement

On the side, Gu Chen's eyes widened when he saw this scene, his eyes full of disbelief.

"This, you,"

For a moment, Gu Chen, who had been invincible for half his life, didn't know what to say.

He had never heard of this method.

But he understood one thing.

The mysterious man named Lu Daosheng in front of him is stronger than himself, and much stronger.

Immediately, Gu Chen looked at Lu Daosheng with a hint of respect.

The strong are worthy of respect.

Besides, Lu Dao's birth and death of this evil demon god can be said to have immeasurable merits.

At this time, Lu Daosheng slowly raised his right hand, and an indescribable force gathered from his palm.

This time, he will erase all the evil demons in the abyss.

Feeling the fall of the evil god, the entire abyss began to tremble.

fear.

A strong fear overflowed from the abyss.

Seeing this scene, Gu Chen looked shocked.

It turns out that these guys are also afraid.

However, in the face of absolute strength, these evil demons have no choice.

Buzz —

Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand, and suddenly, the entire abyss was shrouded under Lu Daosheng's palm.

The next moment, countless black dots gathered in Lu Daosheng's hands.

If these black dots are enlarged hundreds and thousands of times, you will suddenly find that these black dots are all evil devils.

In order not to hear the shrill scream, Lu Daosheng directly isolated his voice.

After a moment, there was no movement in the abyss.

Only the pure energy in Lu Daosheng's hand was left.

"Are you the Lord of the Wilderness City?"

At this time, Gu Chen asked from the side.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded, "Do you know the Huangcheng?"

It seems that the Huangcheng has just been established. Will Gu Chen, as a person from millions of years ago, know about Huangcheng?

Gu Chen shook his head.

"I haven't heard of it, but I'm looking forward to the appearance of Huangcheng now."

"I'll go with you."

Gu Chen was completely impressed by Lu Daosheng's strength at this moment.

I don’t know how long it takes to cultivate this kind of strong man to achieve such strength.

However, Gu Chen may be disappointed with the appearance of Huangcheng.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng touched his nose. Huangcheng was still the same as before and he had not changed it yet.

However, he believed that the future of the deserted city would definitely be far from comparable to that of now.

"This is for you."

Lu Daosheng handed the pure energy left by erasing the evil demons in his hand to Gu Chen.

Take the essence and remove the dross.

Now, Lu Daosheng's hands are the essence of those evil demons.

Seeing this, Gu Chen hesitated for a moment and then put it away.

This thing is extremely precious.

Lu Daosheng doesn't like it, but now he needs it very much.

The stronger the strength, the more terrifying the resources the need is.

"Where is the deserted city?"

At this time, Gu Chen asked.

"It's in the deserted state of Tianxuan World."

Upon hearing this, Gu Chen suddenly began to think.

But no matter how he thinks, he can't remember any major power city in the deserted state of Tianxuan World.

As for the deserted city, Gu Chen has never heard of it.

"Just follow me."

Seeing Gu Chen's expression of confusion, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, then drew slightly to the space in front of him, and a time and space tunnel appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

"Let's go."

Gu Chen glanced at Lu Daosheng, then stepped in.

.........

The deserted city.

In a restaurant.

"Your father hasn't agreed yet?"

An old man with alcoholic smell frowned and asked Lu Xue in front of him.

Lu Xue shook her head.

"Senior, don't worry, my dad will agree soon, but,"

"Just what?"

The old man's expression became less and less beautiful.

It would be so difficult for me to come to this broken city to accept a disciple?

If this girl hadn't seen that she had good talent and was so smart, she wouldn't even wait.

At this time, Lu Xue lowered her head and said, "My father said he would find me a master."

Hearing this, the old man sneered.

In this broken place in a corner, what kind of strong man can the so-called city lord find?

It is estimated that the Breaking Air Realm is at its peak.

"Forget it, then I'll go and see what kind of master your father has found for you."

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded.

But then, the old man said again, "But I will agree first. If the person your father is looking for is not as good as me, then I will take you away directly."

Suddenly, Lu Xue hesitated a little again.

"Senior, are you too anxious?"

When she really wanted to leave her father, she hesitated again.

Because she has never truly left Lu Daosheng since she was a child.

Seeing Lu Xue like this, the old man sneered in his heart, then said indifferently: "Since that's the case, I won't have to do this anymore. Just choose another one and say goodbye."

Suddenly, the old man turned his head and left.

Seeing that the strong man he had finally met was really leaving, Lu Xue suddenly panicked.

"Senior, senior, wait, I, can't I promise you?"

Hearing this, the old man sneered in his heart, "I can't cure you a little girl who is not very experienced in the world?"

Then he gave Lu Xue a step and headed towards the city lord's mansion.

At the same time, in the city lord's mansion.

Gu Chen looked around and frowned.

"Is this your deserted city?"

It is really a desolate, wild land.

Lu Daosheng smiled awkwardly, and then said seriously: "Mountains are not high, but immortals are magical; water is not deep, but dragons are magical. This is a humble room, for my virtue is fragrant."

Hearing this, Gu Chen did not refute.

With Lu Daosheng's strength, he really deserves this sentence.

However, Lu Daosheng is so powerful, this place should not be just like this.

Just when Gu Chen was puzzled, Lu Daosheng coughed lightly.

"Do you remember what I said?"

Hearing this, Gu Chen no longer thought about it, and then said: "What do you want me to help?"

Lu Daosheng helped him solve the evil demon disaster, so if Lu Daosheng has any trouble, he is still very happy to help within his ability.

At this time, Lu Daosheng smiled and said: "It's not a difficult thing. Next, I have to rectify this desolate city, so I may be a little busy, and I have a daughter, who just happens to lack a master, so, "

" Do you want me to help you take care of my daughter?"

Gu Chen said immediately.

He could never have imagined that such a strong man would go all the way to find him to help him look after his daughter.

He was ready to sacrifice his life.

The result was just playing house.

Looking at Gu Chen's speechless face, Lu Daosheng coughed lightly and said, "My daughter is also very good."

Before he left, he felt Lu Xue's physical condition a little.

His daughter seemed to have good talent.

Hearing this, Gu Chen shook his head and sighed.

"Okay, but let me make it clear first, I won't help you look after your daughter forever. After a hundred years, emm, a thousand years, I will leave."

I wanted to say a hundred years, but thinking of what Lu Daosheng had done, Gu Chen changed it to a thousand years.

Although I felt a little sorry for Lu Daosheng, I really didn't have so much extra time.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng naturally agreed.

Not to mention a hundred years, ten years would be fine.

Because soon, the deserted city will undergo earth-shaking changes, and Gu Chen will soon forget this agreement.

Then, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Come, I'll take you to see my daughter. She admires the strong and should like you very much."

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly looked at Gu Chen again, and then waved his hand, and Gu Chen's strong sense of oppression was completely restrained.

"Don't scare my daughter."

Gu Chen:......

"Dad!"

Not far away, Lu Daosheng saw Lu Xue leading an old man coming from a distance.
